name: Top Glove Corporation Bhd.
overview: 2026年，Top Glove 未在公告中披露任何产能扩张、新业务、缩减或出售事项；公告主要为季度业绩、股份分拆上市、董事委员会成员变动及公司秘书变更。最新季度（2026-08-31）营收同比增长39.7%，净利润同比增长352.6%。
overview_en: In 2026, Top Glove did not disclose any capacity expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment in its announcements; announcements mainly covered quarterly results, additional listing/subdivision of shares, changes in board committee members, and company secretary changes. The latest quarter (2026-08-31) saw revenue up 39.7% YoY and net profit up 352.6% YoY.
